card.name: "By" before a named discoverer or method
card.fires_on: The word "by" (or a comma or first name) that introduces who developed or discovered something, or the method used to empty the stomach after an overdose.

modes.label: Credit to a person
modes.description: "By", a comma or a first name right before a named scientist who developed or discovered something.
modes.example: The first vaccine was developed in 1796<< by>> Edward Jenner to prevent smallpox.

modes.label: Method after overdose
modes.description: "By" introducing how the stomach is emptied, such as vomiting or lavage.
modes.example: In the event of overdosage, the stomach should be emptied<< by>> inducing vomiting or by gastric lavage,
